pages.title: Shapeless recipe
pages.label: Combine → one result
pages.text: Friendly Slime + a book. Starts waiting with a mustache and baton. Each shared-owner group may release one commander.

Right-click to open Companions or Players. The tuner opens ordinary stats and also has a roster button. Companion rows show last-known health, orders, work state, location, and whether the companion is loaded, unloaded, stored, broken, or removed. Hover a row for its position.

Select a companion, type a tag, and choose Save tag. Gather uses the typed tag, even without a selected row. Tags have at most 24 characters and ignore letter case. A blank tag selects untagged companions.

Starting Gather spends 25 stamina. It processes living released companions one at a time, including recorded unloaded chunks and other dimensions. They arrive in safe loaded spaces around the commander and wait. Stored, broken, removed, mounted, and passenger companions are excluded. A gathered commander also cancels its own unfinished gather.

One temporary source chunk is kept ticking at a time; unavailable or unsafe destinations are skipped. Each source has a five-second wait limit and commands have a five-second cooldown. Recovery or a restart cancels an unfinished gather. Other traits remain intact. Stored and broken commanders do not occupy the group’s slot.

Only the primary owner sets shared owners and enemies. Direct or indirect shared-access links form one group, including one-way links. Each group may have one living released commander across all dimensions, including unloaded ones. Recover one before merging two occupied groups. See $(l:cooperation/ownership)Shared ownership$().
